name: Death Room
source:
You wake up in a room.

Four white walls. Four strangers. Countless weapons around you.

Your choices decide whether you live or die. Can you escape the Death Room?

[From [url=http://dreamgazer.itch.io/death-room]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一间房间里醒来。

四面白墙，四名陌生人，身边有数不清的武器。

你的选择决定生死。你能逃出死亡房间吗？

[来源：[url=http://dreamgazer.itch.io/death-room]Itch.io[/url]]
